_comment: Copy this file to setup/tools.local.json to add your own tools. Each entry in entries uses the same fields as setup/tools.json, for example: {"id": "my-tool", "name": "My tool (what it does)", "area": "tools", "check": "Test-Command mytool", "install": ["winget install --id Example.MyTool -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements"], "check_mac": "command -v mytool", "install_mac": ["brew install mytool"], "check_linux": "command -v mytool", "install_linux": ["$SUDO apt-get install -y mytool"]}. Updates never touch setup/tools.local.json; an id already in setup/tools.json is refused.
